title: BEETL Competition 2021 Motor Imagery Dataset A — transfer learning benchmark
description: Beetl2021-A is a preprocessed four-class motor imagery EEG dataset (rest, left hand, right hand, feet) from Task 2 of the BEETL Competition at NeurIPS 2021. It contains 63-channel recordings at 500 Hz from healthy participants playing an online BCI racing game (Cybathlon2020IC), with 1490 trials of 4 s each in a single session. It serves as a benchmark for transfer learning and domain adaptation across heterogeneous EEG datasets and subjects, and is re-hosted in BIDS format via the MOABB pipeline.
methods_description: EEG was acquired at 500 Hz from 63 channels (1005 montage) during an online BCI racing game with visual feedback. Each subject completed 5 training races and 10 testing races, with 4 s trials. Online and offline preprocessing included 1-100 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch filtering.
